prompt: What should the crew conclude about the machine’s two functions?
promptZh: 清潔人員應如何判斷這台機器的兩項功能？

options.text: Neither washing nor dry pickup is available this afternoon.
options.zh: 今天下午既不能洗地，也不能用乾式吸頭清理。
options.whyZh: 洗地的確暫停，但這不妨礙使用獨立的乾式吸頭。

options.text: Dry pickup is still possible even though washing must wait.
options.zh: 仍可用乾式吸頭清理，但洗地要等。
options.whyZh: 集水橡膠條破了，今天下午不要用這台機器洗地；獨立的乾式吸頭仍能用。

options.text: Washing can continue if the crew leaves off the dry head.
options.zh: 只要不裝乾式吸頭，就可以繼續洗地。
options.whyZh: 卸下乾式吸頭解決不了集水橡膠條破損的問題。

options.text: Both functions can continue because the dry head still works.
options.zh: 乾式吸頭還能用，所以兩項功能都可以繼續。
options.whyZh: 乾式吸頭能用，不代表可以繼續洗地；主管明確說下午不要用機器洗地。

explanationZh: 集水橡膠條破了，今天下午不要用這台機器洗地；獨立的乾式吸頭仍能用。
evidence: Please don’t use the scrubber to wash the floor this afternoon. / The separate dry head still works.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Please don’t use the scrubber to wash the floor this afternoon.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The separate dry head still works.

vocabulary.note: 此處是洗地機上回收水的膠條
